title: Codex is Live in Zed
snapshot_note: Structured fact packet distilled from Zed's public Codex launch post dated 2025-10-16.

facts.statement: Zed says Codex is supported out of the box through ACP.
The post says users can select Codex from the New Thread menu, alongside Claude Agent or Gemini CLI.
The post says billing and legal terms for Codex are directly between the user and OpenAI.
The post says the Codex agent runs terminal commands in its own process and streams terminal output bytes to the client.
The post says non-PTY terminal mode can reduce interactive polish while avoiding some deadlocks that appear when interactive commands wait for human input.
